hero.h1: Stop sending the same CV to every job.
hero.lede: Paste a job ad. Get a 2-page CV made for that job, from your own experience.
hero.picture_label: Three job ads for graphic designers, each with a CV clipped to it. In the first state the three CVs are identical grey photocopies. In the second, each CV is cut to fit its ad and starts with that ad's top three keywords.

hero.caption_off: One CV, copied for three different jobs.
